mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.2%) signals sustained monetary accommodation that lowers discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% indicates severe labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST below 700k) and industrial production (INDPRO below 97.0) signals broad economic contraction that reduces corporate profit expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST < 700.0 and INDPRO < 97.0.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS above 100k monthly) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 650k units signal a contracting residential sector that reduces economic activity and corporate revenue growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when HOUST is below 650.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) indicates aggressive monetary stimulus for a weak labor market, anticipating economic recovery and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2% and UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 12-month moving average) reflects supply-side constraints that reduce corporate profitability and trigger negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average.
